name: WebAssembly hello
description: Example of an isolated WebAssembly module: writes a text label on the canvas.

capabilities.title: Say hello
capabilities.description: Put a text label on the canvas.

capabilities.title: Loop forever (limit test)
capabilities.description: Runs until the time limit stops it. For tests. Needs go=true, so the install self-test skips it.

capabilities.title: Grow memory (limit test)
capabilities.description: Asks for as much memory as it can get. For tests. Needs go=true, so the install self-test skips it.

capabilities.title: Trap (limit test)
capabilities.description: Fails on purpose. For tests. Needs go=true, so the install self-test skips it.

capabilities.title: Oversized output (limit test)
capabilities.description: Returns more than the output limit. For tests. Needs go=true, so the install self-test skips it.
